Klipsch GiG Black Portable Speaker, Black I really wanted to like this speaker. It comes complete with international plugs, an a/c wall charger, and two pouches which I assume is one for the unit and one for the accessories. It is somewhat attractive with a built-in stand that allows you to either place it on its side or in an upright position.

With most speakers, once you have paired it with your device (an Iphone 5s, in my case), you should be all done. This is not so with this unit. The speaker has a spring-loaded slide switch that you push on. It gives you a guitar confirmation tone so that you know that it's working. Now you must go to the "Settings" icon on your device and manually choose the Klipsch speaker. Then you will hear another guitar confirmation tone letting you know that it is paired. You must do this EVERY SINGLE TIME. It is ridiculous. Of course when you turn it off, it will give you yet another guitar confirmation tone.

The sound is very good, but the extra step of always having to re-enable the bluetooth connection through "Settings" totally negates anything positive about this speaker. There is absolutely no reason why my Sony SRSX5 and my JBL Charge automatically pair with my device whenever I turn them on, and yet this one does not. I keep trying to understand why the developers came up with this procedure, but it totally baffles me.

I know that other users have complained in the past about charging issues. Perhaps Klipsch listened to them and fixed this problem because I have not had any difficulties with that.

If you're gonna spend money on a good speaker, please look at the Sony SRSX5. It is an outstanding speaker with logical functions and exceptional sound.
text_fidelity_b: Klipsch GiG Black Portable Speaker, Black

text_fidelity_a:
Canon EOS Rebel T3i Digital SLR Camera with EF-S 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6 IS Lens (discontinued by manufacturer) **Please note that this review was written by a novice photographer.
I have been asking my husband for a camera for years. You know how it is....the entire time he is taking pictures with his Nikon D80 (he fancies himself a fantastic photographer...and he is), I am constantly in his ear telling how what I see and envision would make a better picture. I also tell him how he should take a picture of something that I believe will make him the next Ansel Adams. And I complete the photo shoot with, "if only I had really good camera, I would"..... Well, I guess he was tired of hearing it, and decided to buy me this camera (for Christmas thru Amazon) if for no other reason than to shut me up. I guess it was his way of putting "his" money where "my" mouth is, and I was delighted.

Now what is there to like about this camera.
-This camera is user friendly and great for a beginner photographer or at least one that is ready to move from a camera like a Nikon CoolPix. It is perfect for still shots and video (HD). It is easy to select a setting (portrait, action, etc), point and shoot. It focuses automatically (press halfway) and can be manually adjusted (tight or far away photos). There is a menu that allows you to edit and even make images, black and white. **Please note that this is the one feature that no matter how much I read the manual, I can't quite get it to do what I would like. I can edit a picture, change it to black & white, and even use the zoom tool, but when I attempt to save it, it won't. That is a feature that I will have to continue to fool with. And if anyone can help me, I would appreciate it.
-You can manipulate the viewing screen...it flips out and turns (for use while recording video) so that you can view it. Or you can swivel, flip and turn the screen around and collapse it against the body of the camera. This allows you to see or view the pictures you are taking or have taken.
- This camera takes crisp/clear photos. They are amazingly clear.
-This camera has a continuously shoot feature/function. It is great for my son's wrestling matches.
-This camera has an automatic flash that is useful if you aren't sure about the lighting.
-This camera is light (weight wise) enough to carry around for a long period of time (your hand won't get tired), but it also comes with a comfortable and adjustable neck strap. There are also cords that come with the camera so that you can use with the computer or TV.
-The battery life is decent. I assume that it also depends on how many videos you do versus still shots. However, I have done both and found and didn't have a problem. This camera also comes with a convenient battery charger.
Overall, I love my new Canon Rebel T3i and look forward to (a) learning everything about it that I can and (2) taking tons of fantastic pictures for years to come.
text_fidelity_b: Canon EOS Rebel T3i Digital SLR Camera with EF-S 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6 IS Lens (discontinued by manufacturer)

Kindle Keyboard 3G, Free 3G + Wi-Fi, 6" E Ink Display - includes Special Offers & Sponsored Screensavers After running out of space for bookcases and space *on* those bookcases, it was suggested that I look into getting an ebook reader. I decided to give a Kindle a try, and it's made the transition from paper to e-ink a mostly painless transition. The Kindle Keyboard is lightweight - even with a cover it's light enough to hold for long periods of time and usually thinner than most books. It's a little bigger than most paperbacks but smaller than hardcovers, to I can fit it into a larger purse and take it with me if I'll have time to kill during any appointments. Of course, it makes traveling much, *much* easier as now I only need to pack the Kindle and one book to read during that 'power off all electrical devices' time.

The 3G version allows more connectivity but does drain the battery faster. If you want to conserve energy, you can turn it off unless you are downloading a book. The keyboard is small, but I haven't found it too tiny to use when unlocking it for use or searching. My only complaint is sometimes trying to remember when to use the 'Menu' button and the 'square' button for some features - it could be a bit more intuitive (like when to remove a book or sample from the device).

The Kindle Keyboard is only 4GB (actually a little less) and can't be expanded beyond that, but it does hold a lot of books. It's also easy to load books by USB cable and sending via email (to Kindle email account). It's definitely saved at least a bookcase or two! While I would hate to see all books go digital, if you do have an issue with space or you want to have a few books always on hand, a Kindle definitely helps in that regard.

I'd say its about as loud as a dyson stick vacuum on the high setting. This air blaster doesn't have an annoying high pitched whine like some I've used in the past which is good.

The only downside is that the cord is too short. although its advertised as 10 feet long, mine measures out to just under 9 feet.. which is plenty if you only want to clean one PC with it but in my case I have several things in my office I want to clean and it requires moving it around to 3 different outlets to reach them all, if the cord was a few feet longer I'd be able to reach them all from a single outlet. I also wish they'd included a cord holder at the bottom, the domed shape makes it difficult to wrap the cord around the device for storage.

Aside from dusting, this is also really good for use with vacuum bags like space bags.. just attach to the inlet port at the bottom and it can suck all the air out, I find it more conventient than using my upright vac wand attachment for this purpose.
text_fidelity_b: SIN SHINE - Compressed Air 3.0- Multi-Use Electric Air Duster for Cleaning Dust, Hairs, Crumbs, Scraps for Laptop, Computer, Replaces Compressed Air Cans (AD01-Black)

ZUMIMALL Security Cameras Wireless Outdoor-2K Home Security Camera Battery Powered, Outdoor Security Cameras with 3MP Color Night Vision/Spotlight/IP66 Waterproof/PIR Detection/2-Way Talk/Cloud/SD I have been testing and reviewing WiFi cameras for the last five years. Over that time the industry has seen major advances which has led to incredible availability of high quality cameras at very reasonable costs. I have tested nearly 100 cameras and it takes a bit to impress me but I must say this set did just that.

I had no problem setting this camera up on my network. I set it both up after fully charging them in about a half hour with no issues.

Due to security precautions I never use cloud based storage in relation to WiFi cameras because that amount of constant data transfer opens your network to unnecessary hacking. The only cameras that I employ in my home allow for local storage - whether to a dedicated hard drive or individual micro SD held within each camera. This camera can hold up to a 128GB micro SD card. The card will over write the oldest data first - how much footage the card holds is dictated by the settings you select. Due to the fact these cameras only record when motion is detected a 128GB card will hold quite a lot and should suffice for 99% of people.

It’s important to know that by default the camera is set to record and save to the cloud. That can easily be reset in preference settings. In addition if you don’t install a micro SD card your camera will only capture still images when viewing - if you don’t have two extra micro SD cards order two when purchasing this set.

The camera provides a crystal clear 1080p footage and I found the motion activation very responsive. With my mesh WiFi network I encountered no lag in viewing - typically camera lag has to do with individual network properties rather than the camera itself.

The batteries in these cameras are phenomenal and actually last as long as is claimed in the listing. The battery’s life will be dictated by how often the camera is activated by motion but I have had both cameras installed and running now for over 2 months without having to recharge yet.

In my tests I found this to be an excellent budget friendly WiFi camera set that as long as you utilize the micro SD card feature is quite secure. Not having to run power cables is a major advantage and will allow these to be placed in far more places. The internal batteries are excellent and are sure to impress. The app is well designed, intuitive and easy to use even for beginners.

This is an all around excellent set of wireless WiFi cameras that I have recommended and do to you as well.

Thanks for reading my review. I enjoy writing them as I value reading other’s reviews when I’m making a buying decision. I regularly update my reviews to reflect any changes I may discover and to include helpful tips you may need if you purchase the product. I will always make every effort to answer any questions I can as it is my pleasure to help.
text_fidelity_b: ZUMIMALL Security Cameras Wireless Outdoor-2K Home Security Camera Battery Powered, Outdoor Security Cameras with 3MP Color Night Vision/Spotlight/IP66 Waterproof/PIR Detection/2-Way Talk/Cloud/SD
